title: helianthemum montanum var. incanum
intro: Helianthemum montanum var. incanum, commonly known as rockrose, is a flowering plant species in the family Cistaceae. It is a shrubby perennial herb that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. Rockrose contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of rockrose include wound healing, skin protection, and immune system support, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
